compiled_state.title: Add GHA concurrency group to calibration-rollup.yml to serialize PR-merge and cron runs
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## What / Why

calibration-rollup.yml has two trigger classes (on.push for PR-merge, on.schedule for monthly/quarterly) that can race: a PR landing during a scheduled aggregation run causes both jobs to run concurrently against the same tracking tickets. Add a concurrency: group to serialize runs per job class, preventing interleaved appends from corrupting rollup state.

## Files to Modify / Create

- .github/workflows/calibration-rollup.yml — EDIT: add concurrency block at the workflow or job level; group key: calibration-rollup-<job_name>; cancel-in-progress: false (queues rather than cancels; callers should not silently lose their append)
- tests/scripts/test-calibration-rollup-workflow.sh — AMEND (task 8070): add assertion that YAML contains concurrency block with correct group key pattern; cancel-in-progress: false

## Story DD Coverage

- dd-4 (extension): workflow does not silently lose data on concurrent triggers (extends the 'exits non-zero when tracking ticket missing' guarantee to concurrent invocation safety)

## Given / When / Then (test approach)

Given calibration-rollup.yml with concurrency block
When structural test checks concurrency section
Then concurrency.group present and references workflow job name; cancel-in-progress: false

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1: concurrency.group defined per job (not global, to allow pr-metrics and aggregation to run concurrently with each other but not with themselves)
- AC2: cancel-in-progress: false on both jobs
- AC3: Structural test asserts both jobs have concurrency blocks with expected group key pattern

## Testing Mode

RED — concurrency block does not yet exist in workflow file
